    Incoming occurrences in orbit quotients #

    An equivariant map from arrow occurrences to their target vertices descends to every subgroup-orbit quotient. When the action on vertices is free, the arrows ending at a chosen lift are in bijection with the arrow-orbits ending at its quotient vertex: every orbit has a unique representative with that target. This is the combinatorial content of preservation of incoming arrow multiplicity, and hence of the arrow term in the manuscript's local density.
